title: Error contracts for approximate relations
description: Final version (October 2026), with errata; superseded by the monograph Bernoulli Types: Two-Sided Error in Approximate Membership, Retrieval, and Computation, Chapter 12. Separates exact relation truth, construction randomness, and shared source identity; gives scoped operator and invariant-preservation formulas, one-sided query error contracts, and a stored-filter calibration study. Credits probabilistic relational algebra and probabilistic databases.
